title: Rental Catch-Up Charges: Autopay Concession Bands
content:
A Rental Property Service Contracts catch-up charge for a tier upgrade carries an autopay concession read from the contract's own payment history.

| Most recent premium payment posted on the contract | Returned payment billed back on the contract in the twelve months before the catch-up is billed | Autopay concession |
|---|---|---|
| made by ACH | none | 0.03 |
| made by ACH | one or more | 0.01 |
| made another way (check, card or any method other than ACH) | any | 0 |

**Records read.** The payment method of the most recent premium payment in the contract's billing history, and the returned payment charges billed back on the contract, with their dates, in the 12 months before the day the catch-up is billed.

**How the concession acts.** The concession is a reduction rate on the catch-up charge. Every reduction rate the charge carries is subtracted from one in a single sum, and the charge is multiplied once by that sum before its single rounding to the cent.

*Hypothetical:* the last premium payment was by ACH, and a payment was returned eight months before the catch-up: 0.01. Had the return been fourteen months before, the concession would be 0.03.
